issues.reason: With no "the same"/"a certain" cue the scope default is subject-wide (the doctrine's dependent-existential pattern, "every student read some book" -> (Theme (sk_read $x) (sk_book $x))), so reusing the constant sk_notebook_1 inside the per-member rule asserts one single notebook kept by every member of the group, which the text does not state.

gaps_confirmed: Contentful/about of-phrase on a concrete, non-nominalization, non-relational noun ("a notebook OF moth-counts and weather notes"): Possession is explicitly barred for an about-phrase and the Of-oblique is scoped to nouns with an underlying verb, so no carrier is licensed and the restriction is dropped.

Quantified capitalized plural kind-word label ("a few Keepers"): the capitalized-common-noun default is stated as singular-collective only, and the Name-only plural rule covers only a plural referring AS a name, leaving a quantified capitalized plural unrouted.
new_gaps: When a vague/counted plural's distributive predicate takes a DEPENDENT indefinite object, the group-event half that Cardinality keeps alongside the per-member rule has no licensed object filler: a single witness there (Theme sk_keep_1 sk_notebook_1) asserts one shared notebook at group level, and no group-side counterpart of the Skolem-function object is defined.
defect_summary: The rule's object must be the per-binding Skolem term - (Theme (sk_keep $x) (sk_notebook $x)) with (Member (sk_notebook $x) notebook) as a conjunct inside the same conclusion - rather than the shared constant sk_notebook_1.
notes: The group witness, the CardinalityPhrase "a few", the Theme role for keep and the unmarked habitual tense are all correct; only the object's binding inside the rule fails.
